stories.title: Ferris State continues undefeated record, becomes 'Big Noon Kickoff Show's first Division II visit
stories.summary: Not only was Ferris State the subject of Saturday's 'Big Noon Kickoff Show,' the Bulldogs continued their undefeated streak for now 42 straight games.

stories.title: Driver arrested after crashing into building at Clark Retirement Keller Lake campus
stories.summary: The retirement home shared on social media that a vehicle crashed into the lobby of the Independent Living Center on Saturday evening.

stories.title: 2 people hospitalized after Saturday crash, Ottawa County Sheriff reports
stories.summary: The driver and passenger of a Hyundai Sonata were taken to a hospital. Westbound Chicago Drive was closed for roughly an hour while deputies cleared the roadway.

stories.title: 12-year-old student on e-bike dies after crash with school bus in Wyoming
stories.summary: Police say the 12-year-old girl was on her e-bike and died at the scene after colliding with a Godwin Heights school bus near the high school.

stories.title: Standoff with SWAT team ends in arrest, Van Buren County
stories.summary: The man was reportedly armed with an "AR-15-style rifle" and "possessed multiple firearms" as he spent six hours in a standoff with law enforcement on Friday.

stories.title: Man taken to hospital and then arrested following crash, Sheridan Township
stories.summary: The Mecosta County Sheriff's Office believes the man was under the influence during the time of the crash.

stories.title: 18-year-old critically hurt after being hit by a car near entrance to GVSU
stories.summary: Police say crash will take several hours to investigate

stories.title: Muskegon police seeks public feedback ahead of accreditation review
stories.summary: Muskegon police are seeking public feedback as the department undergoes a state accreditation review beginning Dec. 1.

stories.title: Woman killed in Gratiot County homicide, police say son is the suspect
stories.summary: State police say a 22-year-old killed his mother Friday morning in Gratiot County. The investigation remains ongoing.

stories.title: Grand Rapids elementary school receives Blue Ribbon honor
stories.summary: An elementary school in the Forest Hills School District was recently named a Michigan Blue Ribbon School among 20 other schools in the state.

stories.title: MISSING PERSON: 16-year-old Joseph County teen last seen on Thursday in Constantine
stories.summary: She is described as a white female, roughly 5 feet and 2 inches tall, weighing 150 pounds. She was last seen wearing red pajama pants and a sweater.

stories.title: WMU sports, K-Wings will call Greenleaf Trust Event Center home in 2027
stories.summary: Western Michigan University's men's and women's basketball, men's hockey and the K-Wings will take over the arena that will host over 200 events every year.
